arm_command_contract.case_deadline: Require at least full180 before active cutoff. Always GNU timeout180; never shorten original case. Guardian cleanup is charged to the same arm end.
arm_command_contract.normal_environment: No owner unset/impersonation, no CARGO_SLOT_HELD/CARGO_REAL/priority/heavy/general-slot/cache/toolchain/DBUS override; PATH resolves normal installed Cargo/devshell. Keep actual GITHUB_ACTIONS/event/run/job identity. Preserve bus/runtime/cgroup/slices. No ssh local path.

Refuse owner-impersonation request or mismatch, do not sanitize before admission.

arm_command_contract.process_cleanup: Guardian wraps selected child, controller owns Cargo group until compile finishes. Cancellation/timeout signal only recorded live owned groups with pid/starttime validation; await pinned guardian returned status and no children under command120 cleanup bound; missing proof of cleanup stops all later arms, no forced unrelated kill. arm_command_contract.devshell: Actual frozen devShells.default for each arm; actual devShells.genie for automation preflight. Prior proposed #ci did not exist and is superseded.
